parsed.rationale: Two of the four participating records live in 'Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift' (package: Artwork), which is a test file. Under the decision rules, any cluster containing a test-resident record must be treated as a test-fixture no-action. Lifting the CGImage extensions from ArtworkServiceTests.swift into shared production code would couple Core or Artwork production targets to test-only helper semantics. The two Image extensions in 'Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Models and Services/ImageCompatability.swift' may themselves warrant consolidation within that file (they appear at lines 19 and 88 of the same file), but that is a separate, intra-file concern that does not require cross-cluster action here.
